title: forecast.odin comments claim 'the harness never builds' Upgrade_Preview, but harness/run.odin builds one
detail: Round 2's B1 fix added the harness preview path (forecast_preview.dem renders a non-nil Upgrade_Preview via capture_frame), directly contradicting these two comments carried from round 1. Readers auditing the golden path are misled.
recommended_fix: Update both comments: the harness builds a non-nil Upgrade_Preview for forecast_preview.dem captures; nil previews (all other demos) still draw zero extra pixels.

title: forecast_preview.dem header mislabels the first capture '1300ms' and claims 'weather shows NOW' at 31000ms
evidence:
demos/forecast_preview.dem:19-24 — '#   1300ms — preview 1 -> wide:  "2 routes reroute to node 2" +
#            "attracts 1 route" (the magnet) — the REROUTE card, plural +
#            magnet branches; weather shows the surge countdown.
#   31000ms — preview 1 -> standard: b-side 10+20 = 30 == 30 ->
#            "2 routes split - equal cost" + "attracts 1 route" — the SPLIT
#            card; weather shows NOW.' ; demos/forecast_preview.dem:35,55 — 'run 33500ms' / 'capture at 30000ms' ; data/demand.json:61-63 — '"start_tick": 1200,
          "duration_ticks": 1800,
          "forecast_lead_ticks": 600' ; core/warnings.odin:251,259 — 'countdown = sp.start_tick - tick' / 'active = tick >= sp.start_tick'
detail: No 1300ms capture exists in this demo — the first capture is 30000ms. At 31000ms (tick 620) the surge (start_tick 1200 = 60s) has not activated; the run ends at 670 ticks (33.5s), so every capture shows the countdown row, never NOW.
recommended_fix: Relabel the first bullet '30000ms' and change 'weather shows NOW' to 'weather shows the surge countdown' (the surge activates after the run ends).

title: unknown at-verb parse error's want-list omits the new 'preview' verb
evidence: harness/demo.odin:361 — 'return {}, fmt.tprintf("unknown at-verb %q (want draw|spawn|demolish|place|emphasis|lane): %s", fields[2], line)'
detail: This PR added the 'preview' case to the at-verb switch directly above, but the error message's hint lists every valid verb except preview. A demo author typoing a verb gets a misleading hint.
